We are interested in querying: `TRYYSDSYWGCGHGGEY` within `13_VecF1_R2_S13`, `14_VecF1_R2_S14`, and `15_VecF3_R2_S15`, `16_VecF4_R2_S16`, and `19_VecF1_R3_S19`, `20_VecF2_R3_S20`, `21_VecF4_R3_S21`.

#### Imports

```{r}
calculate_levenshtein <- function(query_seq, strings) {
  distances <- adist(query_seq, strings)
  return(distances)
}
```

## Load Data

```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/results/V600-Cluster-DB26Feb24.csv",
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

### Query Aggregate Databases

First, we parallelize the computations.

```{r}
library(parallel)

# Set the number of cores to use in parallel
num_cores <- detectCores()
```

```{r}
# Define Query Sequence id
query_seq <- "TRYYSDSYWGCGHGGEY"
#df[df$f == "19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",]$consensus_sequence[1]

# Perform parallel computation of Levenshtein distances
cl <- makeCluster(num_cores)
clusterExport(cl, c("query_seq", "df"))
distances <- parSapply(cl, df$consensus_sequence, calculate_levenshtein, query_seq)
stopCluster(cl)

# Store the resulting distances
df$query_dist <- distances

# Store percent distances
df$percent_distance <- distances/nchar(query_seq)

# Percent similarity
df$percent_sim <- 1 - (distances/nchar(query_seq))
```

### Iterate over percent cutoffs, merging data

```{r}
error_tolerance <- seq(0.4, 0.3, -0.1)

f_vals <- c("13_VecF1_R2_S13_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
            "14_VecF1_R2_S14_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
            "15_VecF3_R2_S15_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
            "16_VecF4_R2_S16_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
            "19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
            "20_VecF2_R3_S20_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
            "21_VecF4_R3_S21_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv")

result_set <- list()
counter <- 1

## Note:
# should we just subset based on rate?
# tmp_frame <- df[df$percent_distance <= rate,]

# Subset based on min distance + an error rate
#tmp_frame <- df[ave(df$percent_distance, df$f, FUN = function(x) x <= min(x) + rate) == 1, ]# subset data

res_frame <- data.frame()

for (rate in error_tolerance){
  # Subset based on similarity
  tmp_frame <- df[df$percent_sim >= rate,]
  # Demand identical lengths
  tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[nchar(tmp_frame$consensus_sequence) == nchar(query_seq),]
  # Store cutoff value
  tmp_frame$cutoff <- rep(rate, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  res_frame <- rbind(res_frame, tmp_frame)
}

# Drop any runs we are not interested in
res_frame <- res_frame[(res_frame$f %in% f_vals),]
```

# Do this, and instead of counting clonal FAMILIES
#             Count DNA Sequences!




## Query Top 50 families in S19 Using above method

```{r}
# df <- df[df$f == "19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",]
df <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/results/V600-Cluster-DB26Feb24.csv",
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```


### Query Aggregate Databases (wrap in a for-loop)

```{r}
res_frame <- data.frame()
# For index i in top 50 clonal families
for (i in 1:50){
  
  cat("Beginning...", i, '\n')
  # Specify query sequence
  query_seq <- df[df$f == "19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",]$consensus_sequence[i]

  # Store the resulting distances
  df$query_dist <- as.vector(adist(query_seq, df$consensus_sequence))
  
  # Percent similarity
  df$percent_sim <- 1 - (df$query_dist/nchar(query_seq))
  
  error_tolerance <- seq(1, 0.1, -0.1)
  
  result_set <- list()
  counter <- 1
  
  # This needs to be performed for each query sequence
  for (rate in error_tolerance){
    # Subset based on error tolerance
    tmp_frame <- df[df$percent_sim >= rate,]
    # Ensure all cdr3 lengths are the same
    tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[nchar(tmp_frame$consensus_sequence) == nchar(query_seq),]
    # Aggregate by sum for counts
    tmp_frame <- aggregate(Dup_count ~ f, data = tmp_frame, FUN = sum)
    # Store cutoff
    tmp_frame$cutoff <- rep(rate, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
    result_set[[counter]] <- tmp_frame
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
  
  results_frame <- result_set[[length(result_set)]]
  
  for (j in (length(result_set)-1):1){
    tmp_frame <- result_set[[j]]
    colnames(tmp_frame)[2:3] <- paste(colnames(tmp_frame)[2:3], tmp_frame$cutoff[1]) 
    results_frame <- merge(results_frame, tmp_frame, by = "f", all.x = T)
  }
  
  results_frame <- results_frame[ , c("f", colnames(results_frame)[!grepl("cutoff", colnames(results_frame))])]
  
  # Cleanup
  for (nm in colnames(results_frame)){
    results_frame[[nm]] <- ifelse(is.na(results_frame[[nm]]), 0, results_frame[[nm]])
  }
  
  res <- results_frame
  
  res$f.1 <- NULL
  # res
  
  res$f <- gsub("_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", '', res$f)
  
  res <- res[,c("f", rev(colnames(res)[2:ncol(res)]))]
  
  colnames(res) <- gsub("DNA_seqs_in_cluster", "Unique DNA Seqs with Similarity Threshold:", colnames(res))
  
  res$query <- rep(query_seq, each = nrow(res))
  
  ordering <- c("1_L1_sh2_S1",
              "2_L1_lh2_S2",
              "3_L1_sh3_S3",
              "5_L2_sh2_S5",
              "6_L2_lh2_S6",
              "7_L2_sh3_S7",
              "8_L2_lh3_S8",
              "9_L3_sh2_S9",
              "10_L3_lh2_S10",
              "11_L3_sh3_S11",
              "12_L3_lh3_S12",
              "13_VecF1_R2_S13",
              "14_VecF1_R2_S14",
              "15_VecF3_R2_S15",
              "16_VecF4_R2_S16",
              "17_VecF3_R3_S17",
              "18_VecF3_R4_S18",
              "19_VecF1_R3_S19",
              "20_VecF2_R3_S20",
              "21_VecF4_R3_S21",
              "22_VecF4_R4_S22")

  res$f <- factor(res$f, levels = ordering)
  
  res <- res[order(res$f),]
  
  cat("Writing...", i, '\n')
  
  # write.csv(res, file = paste("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/result_tables/", i, '_', query_seq,"_Cluster-DB_Query_24Feb24.csv", sep = ''), row.names = F)
  
  res_frame <- rbind(res_frame, res)
  
}
```

### Query Aggregate Databases for sum of clone_ids (rather than DNA sequences)

```{r}
res_frame <- data.frame()
# For index i in top 50 clonal families
for (i in 1:50){
  
  cat("Beginning...", i, '\n')
  # Specify query sequence
  query_seq <- df[df$f == "19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",]$consensus_sequence[i]

  # Store the resulting distances
  df$query_dist <- as.vector(adist(query_seq, df$consensus_sequence))
  
  # Percent similarity
  df$percent_sim <- 1 - (df$query_dist/nchar(query_seq))
  
  error_tolerance <- seq(1, 0.1, -0.1)
  
  result_set <- list()
  counter <- 1
  
  # This needs to be performed for each query sequence
  for (rate in error_tolerance){
    # Subset based on similarity
    tmp_frame <- df[df$percent_sim >= rate,]
    # Demand identical sequence lengths
    tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[nchar(tmp_frame$consensus_sequence) == nchar(query_seq),]
    # Aggregate by sum for counts
    tmp_frame <- aggregate(cluster_id ~ f, data = tmp_frame, FUN = function(x) length(unique(x)))
    # Store cutoff
    tmp_frame$cutoff <- rep(rate, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
    result_set[[counter]] <- tmp_frame
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
  
  results_frame <- result_set[[length(result_set)]]
  
  for (j in (length(result_set)-1):1){
    tmp_frame <- result_set[[j]]
    colnames(tmp_frame)[2:3] <- paste(colnames(tmp_frame)[2:3], tmp_frame$cutoff[1]) 
    results_frame <- merge(results_frame, tmp_frame, by = "f", all.x = T)
  }
  
  results_frame <- results_frame[ , c("f", colnames(results_frame)[!grepl("cutoff", colnames(results_frame))])]
  
  # Cleanup
  for (nm in colnames(results_frame)){
    results_frame[[nm]] <- ifelse(is.na(results_frame[[nm]]), 0, results_frame[[nm]])
  }
  
  res <- results_frame
  
  res$f.1 <- NULL
  # res
  
  res$f <- gsub("_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", '', res$f)
  
  res <- res[,c("f", rev(colnames(res)[2:ncol(res)]))]
  
  colnames(res) <- gsub("cluster_id", "Clonal Groups at Threshold ", colnames(res))
  
  res$query <- rep(query_seq, each = nrow(res))
  
  ordering <- c("1_L1_sh2_S1",
              "2_L1_lh2_S2",
              "3_L1_sh3_S3",
              "5_L2_sh2_S5",
              "6_L2_lh2_S6",
              "7_L2_sh3_S7",
              "8_L2_lh3_S8",
              "9_L3_sh2_S9",
              "10_L3_lh2_S10",
              "11_L3_sh3_S11",
              "12_L3_lh3_S12",
              "13_VecF1_R2_S13",
              "14_VecF1_R2_S14",
              "15_VecF3_R2_S15",
              "16_VecF4_R2_S16",
              "17_VecF3_R3_S17",
              "18_VecF3_R4_S18",
              "19_VecF1_R3_S19",
              "20_VecF2_R3_S20",
              "21_VecF4_R3_S21",
              "22_VecF4_R4_S22")

  res$f <- factor(res$f, levels = ordering)
  
  res <- res[order(res$f),]
  
  cat("Writing...", i, '\n')
  
  # write.csv(res, file = paste("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/result_tables/", i, '_', query_seq,"_Cluster-DB_Query_24Feb24.csv", sep = ''), row.names = F)
  
  res_frame <- rbind(res_frame, res)
  
}
```
